svg.data-weight-note: 20.5 lb (9.3 kg) with FRUs installed; 14.6 lb (6.6 kg) without (Table 5)
svg.data-depth-note: 19.3 in (49 cm) excluding FRU handles and locking levers; 19.4 in (49.3 cm) including them (Table 5)
svg.data-qsfp-plus-speeds: 40 GbE; or four 10 GbE with a breakout cable
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 4 A at 100 VAC or 2 A at 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz (Table 23)
svg.data-power-input-dc: nominal -48 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 8 A maximum (Table 25)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: three fan trays of two fan modules, hot-swappable; the supplies carry their own fans
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation; -5 to 55 C short term
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 3048 m (10000 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches with QFX3500, QFX3600, QFX5100 and EX4300 members; a Virtual Chassis Fabric leaf
svg.data-qfabric: a Node device, or an Interconnect device in a QFX3000-M system, connected by the first QSFP+ ports
svg.data-optics-qsfp: QSFP+ transceivers, QSFP+ DAC and DAC breakout cables, fibre breakout to four 10GBASE-SR SFP+
svg.data-oob: management ports C0 and C1 (1000BASE-T RJ-45) and C0S and C1S (1 Gbps SFP), with link-speed and activity lamps; an SFP in C0S or C1S disables the RJ-45 port beside it
svg.data-lcd: an LCD showing the host name and the number of active alarms
